messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Portuguese, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Portuguese line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑to‑Word Mapping Table (Italian → Portuguese)**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition | Target Word / Phrase | Back‑Translation (EN) | Status | |-------------|----------------------|----------------------|------------------------|--------| | **A** | preposition “to” | **A** | “to” | OK | | **le** | definite article “the” (plural) | — (omitted) | — | **UNNECESSARY** | | **quai** | relative pronoun “whom” | **quem** | “who / whom” | OK | | **poi** | adverb “thereafter” | **depois** | “afterwards” | OK | | **se** | subordinating conjunction “if” | **se** | “if” | OK | | **tu** | personal pronoun “thou” (2nd sg.) | — (inflection in *quiseres*) | — | **UNNECESSARY** | | **vorrai** | verb “wilt” (future) | **quiseres** | “you will want / will wish” | OK | | **salire** | infinitive “ascend” | **subir** | “to ascend / to climb” | OK | | **anima** | noun “soul” | **alma** | “soul” | OK | | **fia** | verb “shall be” (future) | **será** | “will be” | OK | | **a** (line 122) | preposition “for” (introduces domain of worthiness) | — (integrated in *digna disso*) | — | **UNNECESSARY** | | **ciò** | demonstrative “that” (the ascent) | **disso** | “that (thing)” | OK | | **più** | comparative adverb “more” | **mais** | “more” | OK | | **di** | preposition “than” (comparison) | **que** | “than” | OK | | **me** | pronoun “I” (comparison baseline) | **eu** | “I / me” | OK | | **degna** | adjective “worthy” | **digna** | “worthy” | OK | | **con** | preposition “with” | **com** | “with” | OK | | **lei** | pronoun “her” | **ela** | “her / she” | OK | | **ti** | pronoun “thee” (direct object) | **te** | “you (object)” | OK | | **lascerò** | verb “will leave” (future) | **deixarei** | “I will leave” | OK | | **nel** | contraction “at the” (in/on) | **na** | “in the / at the” | OK | | **mio** | possessive adjective “my” | **minha** | “my” | OK | | **partire** | infinitive nominalised “departure” | **partida** | “departure” | OK |
---
### Items Requiring Attention
- **UNNECESSARY**: *le*, *tu*, *a* (line 122) – articles or subject pronouns that are naturally omitted in Portuguese. - No **MISSING**, **WRONG**, or **GRAMMAR** issues were detected; the Portuguese rendering respects the meanings and grammatical requirements of the source.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Portuguese script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Portuguese text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- **Line 121** - Original: *A quem se quiseres subir depois,* - Issue: none - Corrected: *no change*
- **Line 122** - Original: *uma alma será mais digna disso que eu:* - Issue: **GRAMMAR** – comparative construction needs the preposition *do* before the pronoun. - Corrected: *uma alma será mais digna disso **do** que eu:*
- **Line 123** - Original: *com ela deixarei te na minha partida;* - Issue: **GRAMMAR** – clitic pronoun must be attached with a hyphen. - Corrected: *com ela deixarei-**te** na minha partida;*
```text A quem se quiseres subir depois, uma alma será mais digna disso do que eu: com ela deixarei-te na minha partida; ```
